title: Rank-Deviation Quality: A Distance-Aware Metric for Multi-Answer Retrieval and Ranking Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25318v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Rank-Deviation Quality (RDQ), an evaluation metric for retrieval and ranking systems that adapts to queries with varying numbers of reference items, from a single correct answer to many valid results. RDQ scores a candidate ranking against an ordered reference list (ORL): each retrieved reference item contributes its output-position weight multiplied by a rank-deviation penalty, and items outside the ORL receive zero credit. Application-specific parameters control tolerance to misordering. Larger values emphasize retrieving valid reference items, whereas smaller values place more weight on matching their reference order. The output-position weights can reflect visibility in the application's interface, such as a vertical list or a carousel. translated_title: 排名偏差质量：一种用于多答案检索与排序评估的距离感知指标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25318v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们引入了排名偏差质量（RDQ），这是一种用于检索和排序系统的评估指标，能够适应具有不同参考项数量的查询，从单个正确答案到多个有效结果。RDQ根据有序参考列表（ORL）对候选排名进行评分：每个检索到的参考项贡献其输出位置权重乘以排名偏差惩罚，而ORL之外的项则获得零信用。应用特定参数控制对错误排序的容忍度。较大的值强调检索有效参考项，而较小的值则更注重匹配其参考顺序。输出位置权重可以反映应用界面中的可见性，例如垂直列表或轮播图。与需要绝对相关性等级的指标不同，RDQ基于序数排名操作，标注者可以通过成对或列表式判断来生成这些排名。与秩相关测量不同，RDQ提供了一种更灵活且距离感知的评估方式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为排名偏差质量（RDQ）的新型评估指标，它通过位置权重和排名偏差惩罚来适应多答案检索场景，无需绝对相关性等级，从而更灵活地衡量排序质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Rank-Deviation Quality (RDQ), a novel evaluation metric that adapts to multi-answer retrieval scenarios via position weights and rank-deviation penalties, operating on ordinal rankings without requiring absolute relevance grades.
